ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Git Clone - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "git" in order to clone a remote repository that contain suspicious keywords which might be suspicious

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/git$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ clone\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*exploit.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Vulns.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*vulnerability.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RCE.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RemoteCodeExecution.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CVE\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*poc\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ProofOfConcept.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*proxyshell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*log4shell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*eternalblue.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*eternal\\-blue.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MS17\\-.*")))
